Subject: Request: 2-hour API + Console workshop for OmniRetail onboarding

Hi Naomi,

We signed up for Redwood last week and are ramping our engineering team. We'd like a 2-hour hands-on workshop that covers both the Console walkthrough and an API deep-dive (SDK examples, auth, KV caching basics). Target audience: Platform eng (Priya), 1x backend dev, and 1x product manager.

Do you have availability next week (Oct 19–21)? Prefer afternoons PT. Also happy to share an internal list of questions in advance.

Thanks,
Jordan

[jordan.lee@omniretail.com]

Hi Jordan — great to meet you via email. Happy to run this. Proposed plan: 2-hour slot with the first hour focused on Console (models, routing, dashboard, tracing), second hour on API & SDK (auth, streaming, batching, KV caching demos) + 15 min buffer/Q&A.

Can you confirm:
- Number of attendees and roles (Priya you CC'd?)
- Any compliance or procurement folks who should be looped in (for Dedicated/Private discussions)?

Available times (all PT):
- Tue 19 Oct 14:00–16:00
- Wed 20 Oct 15:00–17:00
- Thu 21 Oct 13:00–15:00

I attached a draft agenda and a short checklist of pre-reqs (API keys, sample repo access). If you like, I can also send a calendar poll, or you can pick a time and we'll send an invite.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
